description: This file defines a report parser class for the 'quantity_cost_ledger' report in an Odoo (OpenERP) module, including methods to fetch analytic account data and register the report.

classes.name: account_analytic_quantity_cost_ledger
classes.description: Report parser class for the quantity cost ledger report, providing data retrieval methods.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report parser and sets up local context with helper methods and modules.

methods.name: _lines_g
methods.description: Fetches grouped analytic account lines within a date range, optionally filtered by journals.

methods.name: _lines_a
methods.description: Fetches analytic line details for a specific general account and account, within a date range, optionally filtered by journals.

methods.name: _account_sum_quantity
methods.description: Calculates the total quantity for a specific account over a date range, optionally filtered by journals.

methods.name: _sum_quantity
methods.description: Calculates the total quantity across multiple accounts over a date range, optionally filtered by journals.
